name: evalora-monorepo
description: Evalora — AI-Powered Assessment, Multi-Domain Learning, and Adaptive Practice Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
